title: 第十三章 我很见不得人吗？女、朋、友？
slug: 和情敌共感后傲娇竹马火葬场了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

与此同时，夏暮正被霍宴年，钉死在沙发与胸膛的罅隙间。

他的膝丨盖，强势地顶进了她的双丨tui之间。

薄唇，正沿着她的颈丨线往下移。

温热的气息喷丨洒在她锁丨骨凹陷处，惹得她微微生理性颤丨栗。

冷冽的雪松气息，彻底将她笼罩，仿佛要夺走她的全部理智。

“叮咚——”

突兀的门铃声，刺耳地响起。

宛如一道休止符，让两人交缠在一起的呼吸，停顿在了刹那。

薄璟琛压抑着怒火的声音，从门外传来。

“夏暮，开门！”

一如既往，带着理所当然命令的口吻。

夏暮的心跳漏跳了一拍。

理智强制性回笼，她咬了咬下唇瓣，只觉得自己真倒霉。

薄璟琛八百年主动找不了她一次。

一做坏事，就被逮了个现行？

夏暮下意识低头看向自己。

衣衫凌乱，堪堪挂在臂弯的居家服领口歪斜，锁骨下方，那些痕迹暴露在空气里。

再抬头，身前是同样衣衫不整的男人。

霍宴年停下了动作，正好整以暇地挑眉看她，看起来，一点都没有要回避的意思。

夏暮咬了咬下唇瓣，深思熟虑后，伸手推了推霍宴年的胸膛，“你先进房间避一下，好不好？”

她自认为对薄家无愧，才能在离开的时候，挺直腰板，肆无忌惮。

可如果被看见，姓霍的在她家里......

肯定免不了会被扣上与霍氏勾结的帽子。

她还要白费口舌，跟薄家那边解释，想想都头疼。

可她偏偏忽略了一件事。

眼前的男人，好像也不是什么好东西。

霍宴年微微直起上半身。

却没急着离开，而是慢条斯理地反手扣住她的手腕。

笑得不怀好意，“我很见不得人吗？女、朋、友？”

摁了半天门铃，没有反应，

薄璟琛心里那股不祥的预感，愈发强烈。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At the same time, Xia Mu was being nailed to death by Huo Yannian between the gap between the sofa and his chest.

His knees pushed forcefully between her legs.

The thin lips were moving down along her neck line.

The warm breath sprayed on the hollow of her collarbone, causing her to tremble slightly physiologically.

The cold cedar breath enveloped her completely, as if trying to take away all her sanity.

"Ding dong——"

The doorbell rang suddenly and harshly.

Like a pause, the two people's intertwined breaths paused for a moment.

Bo Jingchen's suppressed angry voice came from outside the door.

"Xia Mu, open the door!"

As always, with a commanding tone.

Xia Mu's heart skipped a beat.

Reason was forced back, and she bit her lower lip, feeling that she was really unlucky.

Bo Jingchen couldn't find her even once in eight hundred years.

When you do something bad, you get caught?

Xia Mu subconsciously lowered his head and looked at himself.

The clothes were messy, and the neckline of the housecoat that could hang on the arms was skewed, and the traces under the collarbone were exposed to the air.

Looking up again, there was a similarly disheveled man in front of him.

Huo Yannian stopped and looked at her with raised eyebrows. He seemed to have no intention of avoiding her at all.

Xia Mu bit her lower lip, and after careful consideration, she stretched out her hand to push Huo Yannian's chest, "Can you go into the room first to avoid it, okay?"

She believed that she had no guilt for the Bo family, so she could straighten her back and act unscrupulously when she left.

But if she is seen, the person named Huo is at her house...

It is certain that he will be labeled as colluding with the Huo family.

She had to waste her time trying to explain to the Bo family, which gave her a headache just thinking about it.

But she happened to ignore one thing.

The man in front of me doesn't seem to be a good guy.

Huo Yannian straightened his upper body slightly.

But he didn't leave in a hurry, but slowly clasped her wrist with his backhand.

He smiled maliciously, "Am I very shady? Girl, friend, friend?"

I pressed the doorbell for a long time, but there was no response.

The ominous premonition in Bo Jingchen's heart became stronger and stronger.
